reviews.text: Baby Driver is a lovely, action packed film with an absolute gem of a story and it just might be Edgar Wright’s best.
reviews.author: Branyan Towe

reviews.text: The chassis of Baby Driver is the familiar “one more job” predicament smashed and splashed with jolts and sprays of meet-cute romance, catchy music, brass balls, and sheer action.
reviews.author: Don Shanahan

reviews.text: With Baby Driver, Wright delivers a delightful, mid-summer cinematic treat.
reviews.author: Peter Bell

reviews.text: Baby Driver's comparatively small, handmade quality serves it well, making this kinetic piece of entertainment feel less like an anonymous studio tentpole than a personal labor of love.
reviews.author: Brian Eggert

reviews.text: The characters, the action, the music, the direction, the editing... everything here is baked with love like a batch of grandma's cookies. Baby Driver is the reason we go to the movies.
reviews.author: Cory Woodroof

reviews.text: Fast-paced story, heart-pounding action, swoonworthy romance, colorful characters, laughs, gasps, tears, and triumph.
reviews.author: Drew Dietsch

reviews.text: I have a hard time believing I'll see another movie this year as consistently entertaining and jaw-dropping.
reviews.author: Kip Mooney

reviews.text: Between the character dynamics, the vehicular stuntwork, and the carefully chosen soundtrack, Baby Driver clicks on all cylinders -- at least until it hits the homestretch.
reviews.author: Matt Brunson

reviews.text: Everything outward lurches and spins if the baby's not running proper, and I smelled me a lemon.
reviews.author: Jason Adams

reviews.text: Sexy, sleek, and stylish, 'Baby Driver' is more than just an exhilarating take on a familiar genre; it's a magnificent mash-up of music and movies.
reviews.author: Michael J. Casey

reviews.text: An all-thrills chase flick with a killer soundtrack, Baby Driver has everything.
reviews.author: Nick Levine

reviews.text: Baby Driver is an inspiring reminder of what the combination of sound and visuals can do for a familiar story.
reviews.author: Ian Brill

reviews.text: Edgar Wright is cementing himself as one of our most pleasing directors of the past decade and has created a Baby that we all can love.
reviews.author: Leo Brady

reviews.text: Succumbs to cliché near the end but for most of its running time is an exhilarating ride, fuelled by a tank full of adrenaline.
reviews.author: Richard Crouse

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a nonstop ride from start to finish, that's equal parts hilarious as it is thrilling.
reviews.author: Jordy Sirkin

reviews.text: None of the characters are authentic in this gun-blazing, high-stakes heist film setting.
reviews.author: Mike Massie

reviews.text: A high-octane thrill ride with a fantastic soundtrack.
reviews.author: Paul McGuire Grimes

reviews.text: ...a mind-blowing merging of action, wit, and music...
reviews.author: Leigh Monson

reviews.text: It's been quite awhile since I've laughed and clapped in an action flick.
reviews.author: Richard Propes

reviews.text: This is Edgar Wright's visual album.
reviews.author: Kelechi Ehenulo

reviews.text: It may not have enough of what you want from it, but it's there. It's Edgar Lite.
reviews.author: Matt Cipolla

reviews.text: There's not a dull moment in Baby Driver. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Ricardo Gallegos

reviews.text: While I appreciate the meticulous care and deft editing that went into crafting the film, I still find "Baby Driver" completely insufferable.
reviews.author: Brent McKnight

reviews.text: This is the film Wright was born to make. The only thing missing is Simon Pegg.
reviews.author: CJ Sheu

reviews.text: Baby Driver is one of the most original heist films ever made.
reviews.author: Damond Fudge

reviews.text: The film has grace, rhythm and music for a while with the story of the young man who only yearns to escape the crime world to rebuild his life. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Yasser Medina

reviews.text: It was like Birdman: Tokyo Drift.
reviews.author: Andrew Galdi

reviews.text: It definitely feels like a 17 to 18 year-old boy's -- who just discovered Tarantino and Bullitt -- wet dream.
reviews.author: Avaryl Halley

reviews.text: Above all other things, Baby Driver is unfiltered entertainment, and sometimes that's exactly what the Doc ordered.
reviews.author: Steven Prokopy

reviews.text: The film is sweet and funny, if that's what you'd like in an action film.
reviews.author: Rhodé Marshall

reviews.text: This is pure filmmaking from a pure filmmaker with a pure vision, drawing from a well of creativity, film fandom, and a deep, abiding love for the craft.
reviews.author: Dan Scully

reviews.text: Baby Driver is the kind of movie that justifies going to the movies...
reviews.author: Tim Brennan

reviews.text: We hollered and clapped. It's that kind of movie. Ultimately cool.
reviews.author: Sarah Knight Adamson

reviews.text: It should definitely been seen in the theater, if for no other reason than to fully experience the mesmerizing sound design.
reviews.author: Chris McCoy

reviews.text: podcast review
reviews.author: Julian Lytle

reviews.text: Stylish, beautifully executed, and slick as a '65 Mustang.
reviews.author: Leslie Combemale

reviews.text: In a word: awesome. Not only is it distinctly unique, Baby Driver also delivers much more than just a musical gimmick. See this movie yesterday.
reviews.author: Kieran McLoone

reviews.text: Baby Driver is massively excellent with its sublime music, witty dialogue, masterfully dynamic editing, and blood pumping action. An undeniably satisfying concoction mixed with a sing-along, a dance number, and your favorite heist film.
reviews.author: Chris Sawin

reviews.text: 'Baby Driver' is pure classicism and the freshest innovation. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Víctor López G.

reviews.text: The responsibility for such a great "abnormality" lies in a single point: The prodigious work carried out in the trio direction-editing-sound editing. [Full Review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Sergio Benítez

reviews.text: The real star is [Edgar] Wright's screenplay and direction. He balances romance, comedy, and action without taking away from any element.
reviews.author: Karl Delossantos

reviews.text: It's hilarious, of course, but it's also legitimately incredible filmmaking, and it does things that I've simply never seen in a movie before
reviews.author: Oscar Goff

reviews.text: An amazing showcase for one of modern cinema's most fascinating visual stylists.
reviews.author: Dominic Griffin

reviews.text: By the time Baby Driver becomes cool, it is too late to be as cool as it assumed it always was. The end result is a slightly-above-average mixed bag that everyone will overpraise for a few weeks and then largely forget about.
reviews.author: Ryan Syrek

reviews.text: ...a half-baked, juvenile script doesn't bring any pathos to the flashy film...it's ultimately a hollow experience.
reviews.author: Mike Vanderbilt

reviews.text: Wright's directorial wit lends the film its infectious exuberance - taking a classic tale of young love on the run and turning it into a Bonnie and Clyde adventure for a new generation.
reviews.author: Mattie Lucas

reviews.text: The film's conclusion, when it comes, suggests the reality that one cannot ever really ride off into the sunset. That ride off will forever be tinged by the carnage which came before, despite the glossy sheen.
reviews.author: Andrew Kendall

reviews.text: It's a ton of fun that will leave you on the edge of your seat craving more adventures with this gang; don't miss this one.
reviews.author: Kaitlyn Booth

reviews.text: The most pure, uncut Edgar Wright that we've ever seen on film.
reviews.author: Dan Murrell

reviews.text: Every scene of Wright's film is a wonder of choreography, from Baby's walk to the coffee shop to the jaw-dropping car chases, symphonies of revving engines and squealing tires.
reviews.author: Julie Crawford

reviews.text: Fueled by a never-ending, always-fresh soundtrack, this kinetic action-musical is undoubtedly one of the coolest movies you'll see this year.
reviews.author: Adam Patterson

reviews.text: Wright manages to assemble a magnetic cast and throw them into compelling situations while blasting a purchasable soundtrack.
reviews.author: Preston Barta

reviews.text: While it does require some suspension of disbelief to enjoy, Baby Driver is a very entertaining, kinetic film.
reviews.author: Rachel Wagner

reviews.text: Great acting all around, and a special applause for director Wright for combining action, music and drama into one great movie.
reviews.author: S. Indra Sathiabalan

reviews.text: The film is driven by exceptional performances, dynamic action sequences and one of the best, most immersive movie soundtracks of the 21st century.
reviews.author: Allen Adams

reviews.text: Baby Driver is the most exhilarating and original film so far this year.
reviews.author: Doug Jamieson

reviews.text: A uniquely stylish blockbuster
reviews.author: Evan Dossey

reviews.text: A seriously cool movie that falls short when it runs out of originality but still remains good fun to watch.
reviews.author: Matt Hudson

reviews.text: A car chase musical for movie geeks.
reviews.author: Louisa Moore

reviews.text: A smooth cinematic adventure, Baby Driver is the kind of film you're going to want to watch over and over again.
reviews.author: Matt Ward

reviews.text: The plot is almost incidental, it feels like an excuse for the masterful and stunning display of action and rhythm. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Pablo Fernandez

reviews.text: In conclusion, Baby Driver has style for miles ... the whole thing is a sight-and-sound experience, a ride that doesn't let up and doesn't let you go.
reviews.author: Colby Bryant

reviews.text: It's a shallow escapist fantasy and a send-up/celebration of a particular genre ... In short, it's a lot of fun and pretty cool...except when it isn't.
reviews.author: Joel Mayward

reviews.text: People of color are picked off easily, like a retro horror film where the Black guy gets killed first.
reviews.author: Li Lai

reviews.text: Edgar Wright basically specializes in movies that should be completely insufferable but actually turn out kind of great (see: Pilgrim, Scott)
reviews.author: Bob Chipman

reviews.text: Baby Driver marks as somewhat of a departure from Wright's usual style, but it is still undeniably a film that could have only come from his mind.
reviews.author: Jennifer Heaton

reviews.text: There are few films this year that will match Baby Driver in pure entertainment value, a high-octane action flick with the year's best soundtrack and ample humor and character to fuel the motorized mayhem.
reviews.author: Sean Mulvihill

reviews.text: Edgar Wright has delivered a pedal to the floor, high octane action film with a pumping soundtrack and a superb cast that only adds to the fun.
reviews.author: Micheal Compton

reviews.text: If this doesn't make you want to get behind the wheel and crank up the stereo, nothing will.
reviews.author: Johnny Gayzmonic

reviews.text: A really, fun, interesting movie that proves Ansel Elgort is a star.
reviews.author: Kristian Harloff

reviews.text: Completely sober thought here, but the best concert to attend this week is [one where] the headliner is a filmmaker and automobiles are the tools of the band.
reviews.author: Nguyên Lê

reviews.text: Baby Driver offers a fresh take on an exhaustive premise, and delivers a star-making performance from Ansel Elgort. [It's] the sizzling solution to this summer's lack of heat.
reviews.author: Aaron Peterson

reviews.text: Edgar Wright has given us a firecracker of fun amidst a dull landscape of the same old, same old.
reviews.author: Tomas Trussow

reviews.text: An infectiously joyous wild ride that is a testament to the saying, "Let the music play."
reviews.author: Rendy Jones

reviews.text: Baby Driver is an homage to other big, great action heist movies, but it's ambitious as well... It is quirky and effective enough.
reviews.author: Abbie Bernstein

reviews.text: It's thrilling filmmaking, a total blast, and rarely misses a beat.
reviews.author: Kambole Campbell

reviews.text: As an action movie, "Baby Driver" is good, but as an action movie directed by Edgar Wright, it is disappointing.
reviews.author: Asia Frey

reviews.text: Loud, fun, and with a soundtrack that complements the film in all the right ways, "Baby Driver" is like being on a roller coaster, with its twists and turns coming quick and a feeling of exhilaration unlike any other.
reviews.author: Mae Abdulbaki

reviews.text: Let me tell you, the film is just as fun, harmonious and right noted as the Simon and Garfunkel classic.
reviews.author: Lisa Johnson Mandell

reviews.text: It's an impressive high-wire act put on by a director who understands the power of human sincerity in the face of oppressive irony.
reviews.author: Glenn Heath Jr.

reviews.text: In the end, the identity of this unique flick is behind the music and its effect on our lives. Music uplifts us, saddens us, angers us, but most importantly it keeps us moving. Two huge thumbs up for Edgar Wright...
reviews.author: Avram Vargas

reviews.text: With just enough thinking to be thoughtful and just enough danger to feel dangerous, it's a rare balancing act that any film works as well as this does.
reviews.author: Kevin A. Ranson

reviews.text: It is perhaps appropriate that the last time we will (hopefully) ever have to look at Kevin Spacey's smug face is in a film that is as equally proud of itself.
reviews.author: Glenn Dunks

reviews.text: In a perfect world, this film makes all the money that is possible and is seen by audiences everywhere. Unfortunately, it'll be yet another film that doesn't get nearly as much attention as it truly deserves.
reviews.author: Damian Levy

reviews.text: Breakneck auto action matched with a stirring sound track, plus a freshly conceived central character -- this joy ride will keep a hip audience strapped to their seats.
reviews.author: Jules Brenner

reviews.text: This is a director having the ride of his life, one going all out to bring the audience along in the passenger seat. Just don't look too closely at what is whizzing past, and you too will have a blast.
reviews.author: Alison Rowat

reviews.text: But whether you're in it for the music or just for the ride, Baby Driver is an entertaining car movie with an engine and a beat.
reviews.author: Amelia Navascues

reviews.text: Wright installs very vital flourishes, detailing all of his characters with quirks, virtues and vices that add color to the already colorful feature...Wright has fashioned a captivating showcase of cinematic wizardry.
reviews.author: Oggs Cruz

reviews.text: It's a movie that doesn't take itself too seriously, but has serious elements. When the two come together, they actually come together quite well.
reviews.author: Jeremy Jahns

reviews.text: Baby Driver is the best car-chase crime musical ever made.
reviews.author: Rick Marshall

reviews.text: This is quite possible the best film [Edgar Wright] has ever made.
reviews.author: Steph Cozza

reviews.text: Edgar Wright's pedal-to-the-metal plus needle-to-the-vinyl action movie is a love letter to the never obsolete wonders of fast cars, pop music and crafty commercial/personal filmmaking.
reviews.author: John Beifuss

reviews.text: It's a real treat to see such a fantastic cast bounce off one another like they do here.
reviews.author: Jamie Neish

reviews.text: It sounds like every noir-tinged crime movie since the 40s, but its a canny reconfiguration of boilerplate elements, made special by the way it taps into our music-saturated culture, using iPods and earbuds to fashion a seductive fantasy world.
reviews.author: Eric Melin

reviews.text: Turns out that this film is a crime actioner wrapped in a quirky musical rom-com, with music and songs informing nearly every scene.
reviews.author: Al Hoff

reviews.text: With Elgort channeling a pouty James Dean and mean Kevin Spacey at his very best, Baby Driver delivers the creativity this summer's films have been lacking.
reviews.author: Eli Glasner

reviews.text: Wright has made a movie that showcases his incredible moviemaking talents and should be instantly included in the conversation with the best car chase/heist movies of all time.
reviews.author: Jason Guerrasio

reviews.text: It's actually a drive-in movie made with art house élan.
reviews.author: Loren King

reviews.text: Wright has tapped a fuel-injected line into cinematic innovation. It's supercharged storytelling at its best.
reviews.author: Courtney Howard

reviews.text: Baby Driver is the first movie of its kind and anything else that follows (unless it's also directed by Edgar Wright) will only be a pale, soulless, bland imitation
reviews.author: Robert Kojder

reviews.text: Wright's ensemble cast has great comedic timing that, coupled with the percussive score and smooth action setpieces, will you ready to peel out of the local theater.
reviews.author: Kristen Lopez

reviews.text: ...a game-changer for the genre.
reviews.author: Danielle Solzman

reviews.text: Baby Driver may not quite hit the heights of Shaun or Hot Fuzz, but it's bursting with invention, stunning action and killer tunes.
reviews.author: Iain Robertson

reviews.text: An exciting mixture of traditional car chase action and modern storytelling conventions.
reviews.author: Wesley Lovell

reviews.text: Fast-paced, exhilarating and impeccably-cast, this action feature is one of the year's best offerings.
reviews.author: John Hanlon

reviews.text: Its obnoxious title aside, Edgar Wright's Baby Driver is possibly the heist, action film that modern pop culture was waiting for.
reviews.author: Rachit Gupta

reviews.text: Wright seems to be taking notes from Quentin Tarantino for his use of pop music to provide an aural bed of energy for the story to glide on. The problem is that Edgar Wright isn't anywhere near as gifted as Tarantino...
reviews.author: Cole Smithey

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a great experiment in the heist-movie genre and with director Edgar Wright behind the wheel, you're sure to have a smooth ride.
reviews.author: Nihit Bhave

reviews.text: A playlist does not a movie make.
reviews.author: Chris Barsanti

reviews.text: It's a breath of fresh air. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Daniel Krauze

reviews.text: Hot-Rod heaven.
reviews.author: Jordan Ruimy

reviews.text: The epitome of cool. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Emmanuel Báez

reviews.text: It turns out to be one of the surprise treats of the summer. There are moments when it's so achingly cool, stylish or technically brilliant (and occasionally all three at once) you want to stand up and applaud.
reviews.author: Matthew Bond

reviews.text: It's appropriate that Baby Driver is a quasi-jukebox musical-one whose marriage of jukebox and diner has been ingrained in the consciousness of American moviegoers.
reviews.author: Ira Madison III

reviews.text: Hands down, the most thrilling, exhilarating, charming and original thing to hit screens in an age.
reviews.author: Jonathan Roberts

reviews.text: Both Ansel Elgort and Lily James are talents on the rise, and deservingly so. There's something quite classic about them, and they bring a real presence to roles that could have been fun but superficial.
reviews.author: Keeva Stratton

reviews.text: Wright has affectionately lampooned the horror and action genres in the past, but Baby Driver proves he is now a legitimate action director in his own right.
reviews.author: James Marsh

reviews.text: Baby Driver feels like Wright is elevating his own game, while tipping his hat to a host of his fellow big-league players.
reviews.author: tt stern-enzi

reviews.text: For a film that desperately throws everything on that screen, it leaves you wanting quite a bit more.
reviews.author: Nathaniel Rogers

reviews.text: An original project in a world full of sequels and remakes. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Israel Acosta Aroche

reviews.text: Baby Driver is so poorly written on levels of plot, characterization and (especially) dialogue that Wright's typically first-rate craftsmanship fails to save it-and, in context, even becomes its own source of annoyance.
reviews.author: Adam Nayman

reviews.text: If I call the film a particularly clear-cut example of style over substance, I am agreeing that the film turned out exactly the way writer-director Edgar Wright planned it.
reviews.author: Tim Brayton

reviews.text: For the rest, on a dramatic level, Baby ... is a total failure: I could not have been less interested in the fate of the hero. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Ernesto Diezmartinez

reviews.text: A classic story with an amazing energy. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Carlos Díaz Reyes

reviews.text: [Edgar] Wright's love letter to the American cinematic tradition of cars and guns is an undeniable blast.
reviews.author: Ned Lannamann

reviews.text: For all its attempts at juxtaposing Baby's sweet dreams with the hard-core aspirations of the movie's band of miscreants, Baby Driver has no more staying power than an air kiss. The longer it goes on, the more fleeting its fleetness becomes.
reviews.author: Robert Denerstein

reviews.text: Baby Driver is the kind of bad boy that our mothers (and electric car enthusiasts) are always guilt-tripping us over. Which means you'll only love it more.
reviews.author: Kaori Shoji

reviews.text: Writer/director Edgar Wright's meticulousness and mastery takes a keen eye on first viewing to get a hint at the level of fastidious planning that went into every aspect of the film.
reviews.author: Blake Howard

reviews.text: An extremely original thriller, an action movie that, unlike most productions Hollywood releases year after year, left me excited and eager to run, drive, and yes, listen to music. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Sebastian Zavala Kahn

reviews.text: Baby Driver is another example (a practically perfect one) that cinema must be fresh and new, not the repetitive monstrosity in which it has become. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Erick Estrada

reviews.text: Baby Driver has more soul and also better action than innumerable movies of the genre. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Erick Ortiz

reviews.text: A film so entertaining that you will want to see it more than once. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Ira Franco

reviews.text: The director, with his enthusiasm overwhelmed to impress the audience with his technical tricks and his impeccable editing work, extends the story unnecessarily and ends up offering a daring denouement. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Luis Fernando Galván

reviews.text: Terrific, character-driven action comedy... Wright again shows his mastery of blending comedy with high-octane action.
reviews.author: Jim Schembri

reviews.text: The film is not going to give you some great insight into the condition of man, but it is going to get you walking out the cinema with the urge to burn some rubber.
reviews.author: Theresa Smith

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a hoot. It's also ridiculous bordering on preposterous, but it's the giddiest you'll feel in the theatre all summer.
reviews.author: Kim Hughes

reviews.text: It may have been an excellent Hollywood entertainment film, but it ended up being slightly better than The Fast and The Furious. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Fausto Ponce

reviews.text: The joy of Baby Driver is that, though you've seen versions of this story before, many times over, you've never seen it done quite like this.
reviews.author: K. Austin Collins

reviews.text: For the film, the ringing sound is an alarm: once the music stops, beware. The soul of Baby Driver dies with it.
reviews.author: Roe McDermott

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a strikingly adventurous and bold action film.
reviews.author: Shingai Darangwa

reviews.text: Even if you're not usually into movies featuring high-speed car chases and gratuitous violence - you'll want to give this one a shot.
reviews.author: Tim Appelo

reviews.text: Hiding the emptiness and the hollowness of the story underneath a flashy hood of hits and misses, Baby Driver shines when moving at top speed.
reviews.author: Marija Djurovic

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a musical in its purest form; it doesn't matter if the characters don't sing or dance - the movie does it for them. [Full review in Portuguese.]
reviews.author: Pablo Villaça

reviews.text: Its blend of speed and music makes 'Baby Driver' one of the year's best films.
reviews.author: Linda Cook

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a super fun action film that uses music as its hook as opposed to over-the-top stunts and special effects.
reviews.author: Matthew Toomey

reviews.text: the action is where Wright's film shines, as he puts the full pedal to the metal in returning us to the old-fashioned delights of real car chases through real streets with real cars doing seemingly impossible moves
reviews.author: James Kendrick

reviews.text: Fans of Wright's work will see plenty of Wright-isms here - the smash cuts, action cut to rock beats, nods to pop culture. That visual wit is now laid over a crime thriller.
reviews.author: John Lui

reviews.text: America gives Wright his boss tunes, his cinematic influences and a ticket to ride. There's also the risk of hubris attached to that freedom, as becomes apparent here.
reviews.author: Craig Mathieson

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a mix of La La Land, Fast and the Furious, Reservoir Dogs and The Blues Brothers. It's funny, exhilarating and entertaining, and definitely worth the ride.
reviews.author: Francesca Rudkin

reviews.text: I walked into Baby Driver wanting, maybe even expecting, to see a film that -- like everything else Wright has made -- would be the stuff of a future cult. What I got was a film that was trying way too hard to be cool.
reviews.author: Graeme Tuckett

reviews.text: The best thing about Baby Driver turns out to be its modest scale, favouring CGI-free action scenes filmed in broad daylight that feel downright refreshing.
reviews.author: Tony Stamp

reviews.text: It's like La La Land meets Gun Crazy. With an irresistible dollop of humor and a dazzling show-off style.
reviews.author: Eleanor Ringel Cater

reviews.text: The movie equivalent of a disposable toe-tapping pop song: mostly pumping, thumping fun, but it just can't play on forever.
reviews.author: Sarah Ward

reviews.text: [It] should appeal to almost every audience demographic: [it's got] tragedy, comedy, romance, action, fast cars, violence, musical credibility and an impressive cast. If there's one criticism, it is that Wright possibly drags things on a little too long.
reviews.author: Chris Newbould

reviews.text: A little style goes a long way. Sometimes it can even get you across the finish line.
reviews.author: Dorothy Woodend

reviews.text: It's all bolted together like clockwork, an assemblage of elements designed to arouse and engage an audience that needs a reason to stop looking at their phones.
reviews.author: Paul Byrnes

reviews.text: Almost every scene that doesn't have a car or a gun in it is cringe-worthy, but as an aesthetic rush and a fun romp it's worth taking in at the best cinema you can. You want to see and hear this thing properly.
reviews.author: CJ Johnson

reviews.text: Baby Driver is too much the soulless good boy doing bad things; what it lacks in substance it can't hope to make up for in style.
reviews.author: Alex Doenau

reviews.text: A remarkable turn for [director] Wright who creates a pulp masterpiece
reviews.author: Felix Vasquez Jr.

reviews.text: Baby Driver is, in a way, the natural culmination of the non-singing musical in recent years.
reviews.author: Stuart McGurk

reviews.text: The action film with the heart of a musical. Ask your local cinema to play it loud.
reviews.author: Cameron Williams

reviews.text: As a storyteller and filmmaker, Edgar Wright has an uncanny knack for teasing the beautiful and whimsical out of even the most unlikely subject matter.
reviews.author: Tim Martain

reviews.text: [Wright's] latest film, Baby Driver, is the sort of rarity that grumps such as myself often complain Hollywood doesn't make any more. Which is to say: a genuine original.
reviews.author: Luke Buckmaster

reviews.text: It's this shifting narrative tone that makes Baby Driver one of the most effective anxiety-inducing films out there.
reviews.author: Gemma Pecorini Goodall

reviews.text: For a film so full of automotive iconography, it's a conclusion that remains frustratingly in the middle of the road.
reviews.author: Hari Raj

reviews.text: In Edgar Wright's glibly stylish drama, bank raids and getaways are carefully choreographed in time to the music. This is mildly interesting at first, but fails to disguise the fact that this is a bog-standard genre picture.
reviews.author: Paul Whitington

reviews.text: In a nutshell, there is not enough of a sense of vulnerability or struggle to Baby, meaning we don't really care that much what ultimately happens to him either way. This is a cardinal sin in the writing of any protagonist.
reviews.author: Hilary A White

reviews.text: The influences are there, but Wright builds on and subverts them in his hugely entertaining movie, one of the most satisfying films of its type to emerge in quite a while.
reviews.author: David Stratton

reviews.text: In Baby Driver, what begins slow amps up towards the third act until the last chase sequence leaves us a bit breathless.
reviews.author: Brooke Corso

reviews.text: A gloriously entertaining epic obviously influenced by car-chase classics from Bullitt and Vanishing Point to Driver (especially) and The Blues Brothers but, nevertheless, just as obviously emanates from his pop-culture-crammed imagination.
reviews.author: David 'Mad Dog' Bradley

reviews.text: Even with those reservations, I absolutely loved Baby Driver: the marvelous soundtrack, the blending of music and choreographed movement, the car scenes that are so exciting that I thought I was being fed megadoses of caffeine.
reviews.author: Rich Heldenfels

reviews.text: It takes a lot of effort to be effortlessly cool.
reviews.author: Matt Neal

reviews.text: Justin Bieber meets James Dean and Route 66 will never be the same.
reviews.author: Ron Wilkinson

reviews.text: After eating exhaust fumes for the best part of two hours, this moviegoer left feeling decidedly queasy.
reviews.author: Vicky Roach

reviews.text: Baby Driver rewrites the four-wheeled film textbook on how to tear up tarmac with style, substance and spectacularly syncopated stunts that just never, ever let up.
reviews.author: Leigh Paatsch

reviews.text: From the very first chase sequence, the beauty in the heart-racing, dance-like choreography is evident and you're totally engrossed. There's no getting off this whirligig ride.
reviews.author: Wenlei Ma

reviews.text: It's been a while since we saw a crime thriller with such a healthy chance of making viewers smile.
reviews.author: Edward Porter

reviews.text: At its best, it affects us like adrenaline mixed with laughing gas. But when Baby Driver, like the Energizer bunny, keeps going and going and going (as with half of Wright's other films, it's 20 minutes too long), it manages to run on fumes.
reviews.author: Michael Sragow

reviews.text: A fairy tale for pop cultists, by a pop cultist.
reviews.author: John Serba

reviews.text: Edgar Wright pumps up the jams in Baby Driver, the best car chase musical since The Blues Brothers. (Admittedly, it's a narrow genre.)
reviews.author: Simon Miraudo

reviews.text: A wonder during its first 30 minutes, but then doesn't know how to handle the arrival of new ingredients. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Mikel Zorrilla

reviews.text: Put in your metaphorical earbuds, turn the key in the ignition, and enjoy the cinematic highlight of the summer so far.
reviews.author: Christopher Orr

reviews.text: A typically erratic effort from Edgar Wright...
reviews.author: David Nusair

reviews.text: It's the incidentals that make Baby Driver something special, from the creatively conceived, meticulously scored car chases to the running joke about people's names and their use in songs.
reviews.author: Margot Harrison

reviews.text: A musical more than a rubber-burner, Baby Driver is the La La Land of caper films, derivative and occasionally fun -- take that as praise if you loved La La Land.
reviews.author: Richard von Busack

reviews.text: An unadulterated auteur w**k.
reviews.author: Ed Whitfield

reviews.text: Fun and funny, if not especially deep, Baby Driver is a movie and music lover's ultimate love letter to movies and music.
reviews.author: Annlee Ellingson

reviews.text: Wright assumes viewers are paying close attention and love obscure references and deep cuts. Thankfully, his obsessions are incurably contagious.
reviews.author: Dan Lybarger

reviews.text: ...the proverbial summer action movie, but done with enough wit and flair that you don't feel like you've seen it over and over again...
reviews.author: Daniel M. Kimmel

reviews.text: High-concept and full of style, as well as brutal violence and hot cars, Baby Driver is the latest from writer-director Edgar Wright, and it's a welcome piece of original filmmaking in a summer of been-there, done-that franchises.
reviews.author: Michael Smith

reviews.text: ...(some) in the audience won't be able to stomach the enormous plotholes in the script, but, for me, they were counterbalanced by the torrid pace. The romance is well done, due in large part to the scintillating performance of Lily James.
reviews.author: Tony Medley

reviews.text: Wright glosses over some plot points in the interest of getting on with things, but the car chases are the point, and they're terrific.
reviews.author: Jim Lane

reviews.text: Amongst the deluge of summer blockbuster and extended universe releases, Baby Driver is a breath of fresh cinematic air.
reviews.author: Liam Hanlon

reviews.text: Edgar Wright's car-chase thriller has so much va-va-voom it will leave you grinning with pleasure.
reviews.author: Jason Best

reviews.text: Edgar Wright used to send up cinematic clichés with gusto and with huge humor. Here he just embraces them - and his sullen, unengaging hero - unironically.
reviews.author: MaryAnn Johanson

reviews.text: Don't believe the hype. This is one bad "'Driver."
reviews.author: David N. Butterworth

reviews.text: A film that has a lot of style and attitude to be a big summer hit. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Daniel de Partearroyo

reviews.text: Superb stunt-driving, a sweet romance, a mess of cliché's kaleidoscoped into hot-dang! storytelling, and the only thing missing is Prince's "Baby Knows," and Patrick Swayze's "Nobody puts baby in a corner!"
reviews.author: Mark Jackson

reviews.text: Edgar Wright's adrenaline-propelled, music-driven crime caper is a gas!
reviews.author: Susan Granger

reviews.text: The man behind 'Hot Fuzz' and 'Shaun of the Dead' has come up with another dandy action film with a comic twist, but this is no parody. This is a cut above the standard crime action drama, aided by Edgar Wright's comic touch.
reviews.author: Robert Roten

reviews.text: Baby Driver is essentially one long shredding guitar solo of a film.
reviews.author: Travis Johnson

reviews.text: Here's a prediction. First-year drama students will soon be Blu-Tacking the hell out of posters for Baby Driver, which will make Edgar Wright at once embarrassed and proud.
reviews.author: Charlotte O'Sullivan

reviews.text: A roaringly high-octane crime movie reminiscent of the best of Quentin Tarantino.
reviews.author: Brian Viner

reviews.text: While Wright is a master stylist, I'm still not convinced he is a great storyteller.
reviews.author: Andy Lea

reviews.text: It's when the horns and drums of the Button Down Brass's Tequila become gunfire, or the madness of Hocus Pocus by Focus drives a breathless chase, that Wright really puts his foot down, with exhilarating results.
reviews.author: Mark Kermode

reviews.text: Everything has rhythm in Edgar Wright's Baby Driver, starting with its original premise, fresh execution and a soundtrack guaranteed to get pulses racing and feet tapping.
reviews.author: Louise Keller

reviews.text: ...the music is something you feel. Music connects every scene, connects every character, every action flows from Wright's eclectic mix of tracks, all special in their own way.
reviews.author: Travis Hopson

reviews.text: Ansel Elgort bops around 'Baby Driver' like 'Saturday Night Fever's Tony Manero, with his ear buds semi-glued in. You keep expecting a few disco balls to pop into view while the Bee Gees let loose on the soundtrack.
reviews.author: Brandon Judell

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a nice twist on an old car chase, car crash, bullets flying everywhere and hitting everyone but the main characters genre. Fun flick.
reviews.author: Gary Wolcott

reviews.text: Boisterous, crackerjack, bubblegum power-pop, adrenaline-stoking coolly-choreographed manic action, fragrant with delight in its own substantial craft, Edgar Wright's zooming genre riff Baby Driver is an epic car-chase confabulation.
reviews.author: Ray Pride

reviews.text: Baby Driver might not live entirely up to the hype, but that doesn't make it any less wonderful, Wright once again showing he's a fearless genre-busting directorial wunderkind who's creative gas tank overflows in originality.
reviews.author: Sara Michelle Fetters

reviews.text: Baby Driver becomes an enjoyment for the palates of the connoisseurs and a joy for lovers of speed, shots, teen love stories, bastards dialogues and playlist wisdom. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Marcos Gandía

reviews.text: Those who do give it a chance should find it to be the kind of pure cinematic adrenaline that will leave them giddy, thoroughly entertained and determined to rush off and tell someone about what they have just seen.
reviews.author: Peter Sobczynski

reviews.text: ...the edits and camera swerves are completely in sync with the songs.
reviews.author: Josh Larsen

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a symphony of style, sound and story.
reviews.author: Josh Terry

reviews.text: A genre-crossing masterpiece with music on the brain and burnt rubber in its soul
reviews.author: Frank Wilkins

reviews.text: A pure visceral joy is written into the film's many set pieces, which have been shot without too many special effects and rolled out at breakneck speed.
reviews.author: Aakash Karkare

reviews.text: It works like a charm, especially when Wright's alchemy is applied to some jaw-dropping chase scenes and in-camera car stunts that make the CGI cheating of the "Fast and Furious" franchise look like amateur night.
reviews.author: Gary Dowell

reviews.text: Go to the movies, sit down, be entertained for 113 minutes, crank up the car radio on the way home - with luck, on a perfectly clear summer night.
reviews.author: Jeff Simon

reviews.text: The astonishing fluidity with which [Wright] puts together the music, editing, and performances gives Baby Driver the sensation of riding in a high-performance car with just the right song coming over the speakers. The world seems to fall into place.
reviews.author: Kristian M. Lin

reviews.text: There are great movies you admire, and then there are great movies you admire that also make you deliriously happy. Baby Driver is the latter.
reviews.author: Mike McGranaghan

reviews.text: Besides the chase sequences, what makes Baby Driver go is the hot potpourri of personalities Baby gets paired with.
reviews.author: Tom Meek

reviews.text: Edgar Wright picked the perfect actor to play Baby. Ansel Elgort slides into this character like it is a second skin.
reviews.author: Jackie K. Cooper

reviews.text: Edgar Wright has been an influential presence in cinema and once again, he delivers in spades with Baby Driver rocketing upwards into the higher echelons as one of the best films to come out of this year.
reviews.author: Ryan Pollard

reviews.text: This is the rare, unique entertainment that takes classic action tropes, and turbocharges them.
reviews.author: Alan Zilberman

reviews.text: It's a wild ride, a highly caffeinated tour de force filled with great action, lots of deadpan humor, and the kind of prevailing coolness that makes you want to drink espresso, troll vintage record stores, and watch old Steve McQueen films when it's over.
reviews.author: Max Weiss

reviews.text: It's pure candy for the eyes and ears, impeccably staged by writer-director Edgar Wright. And we don't mind much that there's not much more to it than that.
reviews.author: Rich Cline

reviews.text: Some of this film is a classic, and some of it's heartlessly superficial. Wright's obsessive cinephilia fuels both.
reviews.author: Nick Hasted

reviews.text: Visually inventive and meticulously edited, it's as much a showcase for its characters on four wheels as those with two legs, providing a visceral excitement while toying with clichés.
reviews.author: Todd Jorgenson

reviews.text: Wright calibrates the noises of sirens, squealing brakes, even gunshots to participate in its pop-to-punk playlists, bringing new bursts of inspiration to familiar tracks.
reviews.author: Jeffrey Overstreet

reviews.text: Car-centric crime action is stylish, but shallow, violent.
reviews.author: Joyce Slaton

reviews.text: In some ways, it feels like a step backward, considering the maturity and pathos that made his previous picture, 'The World's End,' one of his best. Still, you can't blame a director for wanting to pause his growth and play with his shiny Hollywood toys.
reviews.author: Jason Bailey

reviews.text: Fast, violent, and absurd - and the driving is a blast, performed by stunt drivers, not digital effects.
reviews.author: Robert Horton

reviews.text: The only bad part of Baby Driver is the title.
reviews.author: Phil Villarreal

reviews.text: With an intensely supercharged soundtrack driving the frantic editing in this way-cool heist flick, there isn't much fat left to gnaw off the bones by the time the action hits the curb in the final act.
reviews.author: Elias Savada

reviews.text: Well worth seeing on the biggest screen with the best sound system possible.
reviews.author: Sonny Bunch

reviews.text: Pedestrian is not the first word that springs to mind in connection with Edgar Wright's films, but no one has better captured the pleasure of walking while listening to pop music.
reviews.author: Henry K. Miller

reviews.text: The direction, cinematography, stunts, and soundtrack are the true star performers that make the film a fun ride. (Full Content Review for Parents - Violence, Profanity, Sexual Content, etc. - also Available)
reviews.author: Jim Judy

reviews.text: I've never been to the opera, nor have I ever seen a 90-piece orchestra play Beethoven. But I imagine this - the action in this movie - is what it must feel like. Baby Driver is symphonic. It's ecstatic. It's hypnotic. When it soars, it soars.
reviews.author: Rohan Naahar

reviews.text: A rollicking action/adventure/comedy/romance/musical that finds a dynamite angle and sticks with it. Here's a film that's fun, and totally unabashed about it.
reviews.author: Stephen Silver

reviews.text: Baby Driver is often very entertaining but brace yourself for the violence.
reviews.author: Allan Hunter

reviews.text: The disjointed plot of this fast and spurious jaunt frustrates at every corner taken in fifth gear.
reviews.author: Terry Staunton

reviews.text: Within its small failures it would be an act of irresponsibility not to recognize the merits of the electrifying Baby Driver. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Orlando Maldonado

reviews.text: Baby Driver is just good enough to highlight the many ways it could've been a masterpiece.
reviews.author: Walter Chaw

reviews.text: I mean, hot dayum!
reviews.author: Jamie East

reviews.text: Too much works to get hung up on the misses - Wright's film is an absolute blast.
reviews.author: Andy Psyllides

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a blast of pure pop energy.
reviews.author: Alistair Harkness

reviews.text: It takes a scant five minutes for Baby Driver to feel like one of the best car-chase films of all time.
reviews.author: AP Kryza

reviews.text: What a fun and thrilling summertime romp
reviews.author: Molly Laich

reviews.text: Oozing menace as addicted bank robbers, Jamie Foxx and Jon Hamm are all the more charismatic thanks to Bill Pope's luscious noir photography. Credit Jonathan Amos and Paul Machliss for the razor-sharp editing.
reviews.author: Andrea Gronvall

reviews.text: Edgar Wright's Baby Driver is one of the most entertaining thrill rides of this year, this decade.
reviews.author: Richard Roeper

reviews.text: Edgar Wright has delivered the film of the summer, and one of the best of the year, with Baby Driver, a heist movie that tips its hat to past classics while retaining an energy and style that's steadfastly its own.
reviews.author: Rob Carnevale

reviews.text: Baby Driver is an immersive thriller that seduces you to embrace its ridiculously fun excesses.
reviews.author: J.R. Kinnard

reviews.text: I found the movie's slick, shiny surfaces entertaining to a point but once again wish this frustrating filmmaker would go as deep as his debut.
reviews.author: Sean Burns

reviews.text: The car-chase movie reinvented? Maybe, but it just hasn't been reinvented enough.
reviews.author: Deborah Ross

reviews.text: England's Edgar Wright, already a critical and cult favorite, casts a glorious summertime spell with Baby Driver, a speed- and music-propelled gangster saga that transforms into a coming-of-age character study.
reviews.author: Stephen Schaefer

reviews.text: This is summer action done right.
reviews.author: Brad Keefe

reviews.text: This is not a philosophy of criminology, or a new pathology of antisocial behavior, but it makes for a terrific night at the movies.
reviews.author: Joe Morgenstern

reviews.text: Remember the visceral excitement you felt the first time you saw De Palma's Carrie, Scorsese's Raging Bull or Tarantino's Pulp Fiction...? Baby Driver induces the same reaction.
reviews.author: Steve Davis

reviews.text: Wright's movie delivers action that's convincing and concrete - the cars seem real, even when the people don't.
reviews.author: Bilge Ebiri

reviews.text: If you fancy lots of rock 'n' roll choices in your movies, the latest from Brit Edgar Wright seriously steps on the classical gas.
reviews.author: John Urbancich

reviews.text: Elgort creates a thoroughly conflicted, likable character with all the vulnerabilities of a person befitting his youth who has to grow and grow up ridiculously fast.
reviews.author: George M. Thomas

reviews.text: Edgar Wright has an uncanny ability to identify these weird little snippets of pop culture detritus and not only sample them, but in the process give them soul.
reviews.author: Vincent Mancini

reviews.text: As far as car chases go, Bullitt has no edge on this stylish fecal thriller.
reviews.author: Dennis Schwartz

reviews.text: It delights me to report that Baby Driver is a monumental f---ing triumph. This is the best action movie of 2017 and the best thing Wright has done to date.
reviews.author: Patrick Kolan

reviews.text: It's a triumph. It's as lightweight as a soufflé, yet as solid as a Ferrari. And it interweaves the inner and outer lives of its hero lightly but with real perception.
reviews.author: Nigel Andrews

reviews.text: So fun, oddly romantic, and revitalizes the film soundtrack
reviews.author: Candice Frederick

reviews.text: Edgar Wright's start to finish sensation is blessed with killer car chases, a star-making turn from Ansel Elgort, the year's best soundtrack and the most fun you'll have at the movies all summer.
reviews.author: Peter Travers

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a frenetic, funky, fast and manic fun time at the movies you won't want to miss this summer.
reviews.author: Anthony Ray Bench

reviews.text: In a summer of yet more synthetic blockbusters, Baby Driver feels entirely original. This is jukebox filmmaking, a wildly energetic movie whose characters behave in line with the songs that fill its soundtrack.
reviews.author: Geoffrey Macnab

reviews.text: In Edgar Wright's Baby Driver, even the machine guns fire in time with the beat.
reviews.author: Sam Adams

reviews.text: If Walter Hill and Jean-Luc Godard had a movie baby, it'd look just like Baby Driver -- but it wouldn't sound half as good.
reviews.author: Norman Wilner

reviews.text: The music helps distract viewers from the fact that they have no emotional investment in any of these characters or the story itself.
reviews.author: Michael Heaton

reviews.text: Edgar Wright's crackling crime caper rises to the top of this summer's most entertaining movies. It satisfies my need for speed, baby.
reviews.author: Thelma Adams

reviews.text: Lurching between mind-boggling car chases and a cliched young love subplot, the film starts strong and ends weak - both exhilarating and disappointing - but worth seeing for its razzle-dazzle, if mindless, action.
reviews.author: Barry Paris

reviews.text: Baby Driver is an exhilarating and tense thrill ride that's infectious with its high-octane energy, sheer creativity, and strong performances.
reviews.author: Chris Agar

reviews.text: Summer can finally start now: Baby Driver is that blast of energy we've all been waiting for.
reviews.author: Peter Howell

reviews.text: It's like a mediocre crime thriller crossed with several very good music videos.
reviews.author: Josh Bell

reviews.text: Driven by an infectious soundtrack and revved up action, 'Baby Driver' is a gas!
reviews.author: Roger Tennis

reviews.text: ...there is a sequence at the beginning of the film that is pure "Singin' in the Rain" magic. It's a fantastic, absolutely fantastic car chase set perfectly to a pop tune.
reviews.author: Jonathan W. Hickman

reviews.text: Baby Driver is sweet fantasy, unlike more violent and existential vehicular visions such as Drive or Bullitt. That means its two-bit thieves and criminal masterminds (Jamie Foxx, Jon Hamm, Kevin Spacey) are enjoyably cartoonish.
reviews.author: Joshua Rothkopf

reviews.text: The car chase scenes are the guts of this oddball movie, and they don't disappoint.
reviews.author: Dwight Brown

reviews.text: A common criticism of blockbusters these days is a perceived lack of wit or invention -- the sense that big budgets and special effects are often used to paper over fundamental cracks. Baby Driver is an antidote to that feeling.
reviews.author: Martin Roberts

reviews.text: Wright builds his script on the back of a killer soundtrack.
reviews.author: Dana Barbuto

reviews.text: Baby Driver should be seen simply because it is such a bold and wonderful idea. That's why I kind of hate to say that it doesn't pull it off fully.
reviews.author: Matthew Razak

reviews.text: Baby Driver winks at our obsession with money and power, without actually winking at all. The film's palpably sincere heart saves it from being smarmy, and Wright's direction keeps the emotional arcs predictable, but pure.
reviews.author: Katherine Monk

reviews.text: It's the kind of action-comedy that makes you want to see it again a second after it's over.
reviews.author: Calvin Wilson

reviews.text: Action lovers will be impressed by the film's choreography and live stunts, one driver entering and exiting a narrow alley with 180 degree spins.
reviews.author: Laura Clifford

reviews.text: It's a crazy feature, but not consistently so, strangely applying the brakes when the viewing experience is best served at top speed with blazing music.
reviews.author: Brian Orndorf

reviews.text: Underneath Baby Driver's hood is the sweetest on-screen romance in ages.
reviews.author: Christian Toto

reviews.text: Having hooked us with style, Wright knows he has to deliver on the story, and he does. His plotting is tight and fluid, wild and ultimately satisfying.
reviews.author: Mick LaSalle

reviews.text: "Baby Driver" somehow maintains a tone of sweetness even as bullets fly, blood spurts, and gears are stripped. In fact, the movie feels like Tarantino minus the sleaze.
reviews.author: Ty Burr

reviews.text: Cleverly blends elements of True Romance and Drive. Its cult status seems assured.
reviews.author: Matthew Turner

reviews.text: Fast and Curious action flick driven by cool playlist, hot wheels , and style for miles. Love the soundtrack, baby.
reviews.author: Pete Hammond

reviews.text: All you really need to know about Baby Driver is that it's the best film of the year so far, hands down.
reviews.author: Kam Williams

reviews.text: Edgar Wright has little time for genre restrictions. Baby Driver is a unique and engaging presentation that avoids obvious comparisons.
reviews.author: Jeffrey Lyles

reviews.text: Never before has an action thriller been this well executed or wildly entertaining.
reviews.author: Jeanne Kaplan

reviews.text: "Baby Driver" is the "Bullitt" for a new generation of moviegoers almost 50 years later.
reviews.author: David Kaplan

reviews.text: Arguably spins out of control in the last act, but overall it makes for a wild ride that provides the sort of juice you'd expect from a top-of-the-line muscle car.
reviews.author: Frank Swietek

reviews.text: It's a fun genre mashup that's also rather disposable, offering quick surges of pleasure akin to the cavalcade of tasty pop, rock and R&B songs that litter the soundtrack and provide the film's heartbeat.
reviews.author: Tim Grierson

reviews.text: If the use of music is a gimmick, it's a remarkably well-executed one, successfully transforming the familiar material into something buoyant and new.
reviews.author: Eric D. Snider

reviews.text: Walk or take public transit to the theater, as the urge to drive recklessly on your way home will likely prove overwhelming.
reviews.author: Chris Klimek

reviews.text: A hit of speed and cartoonish amusement, smoothly chauffeured on to the screen by Edgar Wright, the man behind Hot Fuzz.
reviews.author: Kate Muir

reviews.text: The results are both familiar and fresh.
reviews.author: Robert W. Butler

reviews.text: Wright has a peerless skill in syncing up his images to the beats and rhythms of a diverse soundtrack, giving new life to tracks that have long seemed exhausted
reviews.author: Barry Hertz

reviews.text: Wright takes his foot off the floor here and there in the second half with too much yapping, but otherwise the mix of hardboiled and heartwarming is just right.
reviews.author: Harry Guerin

reviews.text: As charming as Baby Driver strives to be, the appeal starts to curdle once Wright makes his fetishistic aims clear.
reviews.author: Ann Hornaday

reviews.text: There's nothing like an epic getaway chase to kick a movie into high gear, and the first five minutes of Baby Driver are pure movie magic.
reviews.author: Lindsey Bahr

reviews.text: Although Baby Driver is technically a heist/chase film, what it's really about is how much in love Wright is with what movies can do.
reviews.author: Chris Hewitt

reviews.text: The band Spacemen 3 once titled an album "Taking Drugs to Make Music to Take Drugs To"... Edgar Wright, a major record-head, might appreciate this comparison: He makes movies out of ideas that are too crazy to make movies out of.
reviews.author: Rafer Guzman

reviews.text: Baby Driver finds Wright directly in his wheelhouse -- reverently and knowingly deploying genre tropes with visual style and musical panache -- and his enthusiasm is apparent in each and every frame.
reviews.author: Genevieve Koski

reviews.text: [Baby Driver] is very savvy about pop music and pop culture, and it has a number of thrilling car chase sequences. But those are side items, not main courses, and you can't put dessert before the meal. It winds up driving in circles.
reviews.author: Adam Graham

reviews.text: When Baby Driver gets its engines revved up, it owns the road.
reviews.author: Sean P. Means

reviews.text: Baby Driver is wild, violent, often very funny and hugely inventive. Wright puts you right in the driver's seat with Baby for spectacular car escapades, but the characters and conversations he creates are just as gripping.
reviews.author: Liz Braun

reviews.text: This is movie craftsmanship and showmanship of a very high order.
reviews.author: Justin Chang

reviews.text: Wright has orchestrated every swerve and near smashup -- and one glorious foot chase -- with precision, a rarity in action filmmaking these days.
reviews.author: Stephanie Zacharek

reviews.text: As sharply executed as a hairpin turn, Baby Driver is a crackling-good ride, one that organically weaves music and humor into a slick showcase for its cast.
reviews.author: Brian Lowry

reviews.text: It's less a movie than a feature-length exercise in editing and sound design. While that makes for a thrilling picture, the overall result is a movie that feels empty.
reviews.author: Abby Olcese

reviews.text: Bleeding a special cinematic language while being brilliantly unique, it's put together unlike anything you've seen before
reviews.author: Eric Eisenberg

reviews.text: Fasten your seatbelts. This one is pedal to the metal all the way home.
reviews.author: Nell Minow

reviews.text: Baby Driver comes across like Grand Theft Auto (the game, not the film) as directed by Stanley Donen. It's that much fun. It has that much profundity.
reviews.author: Donald Clarke

reviews.text: A welcomed shot of adrenaline and great music at the movies. [Full review in Spanish]
reviews.author: Fico Cangiano

reviews.text: This film is a whole lot of fun in an inventive package.
reviews.author: Mark Dujsik

reviews.text: The result is easily one of the best rides of the summer.
reviews.author: Chris Knight

reviews.text: There's much to enjoy in "Baby Driver," including the satisfactions of genuine cinematic craft and technique, qualities that moviegoers can no longer take for granted.
reviews.author: Manohla Dargis

reviews.text: The Italian director Bernardo Bertolucci was once credited with making "intravenous cinema", but there's no better imaginable description of Baby Driver, which seems to shoot directly from the screen into your arteries.
reviews.author: Robbie Collin

reviews.text: It's been a week since I saw "Baby Driver," and I'm still pleasantly buzzed.
reviews.author: Sara Stewart

reviews.text: The adrenaline high of this clean getaway lasts for days.
reviews.author: Charles Bramesco

reviews.text: Wright takes music video literalization to breathtaking heights. Baby Driver doesn't operate from its hero's point of view but rather his point of hearing, essentially the same thing. Wright's ingenious approach literally turns the genre on its ear.
reviews.author: Steve Persall

reviews.text: I will not penalize a good movie for merely being good.
reviews.author: Scott Mendelson

reviews.text: What a rush.
reviews.author: Peter Bradshaw

reviews.text: A subtly innovative blend of cars, guns, music and old-school cool, it's also one of those increasingly rare creatures in Hollywood: an undeniably original movie.
reviews.author: Mike Scott

reviews.text: Wright doesn't simply apply technical precision and innovation to genre-smart storytelling - he also makes what must be exhausting work look like so much fun.
reviews.author: Nick Newman

reviews.text: Almost like a radical movie musical, as if La La Land collided with Mad Max by way of Quentin Tarantino.
reviews.author: Neil Pond

reviews.text: Everything in Baby Driver, from the rubber-on-road action scenes to the expositional conversations, is its own kind of set piece, engineered to hit pleasure centers with homing-missile accuracy.
reviews.author: A.A. Dowd

reviews.text: Wright's idea is to grab you by the throat from the beginning and never let go. He is consistent and mostly successful in this aim.
reviews.author: Bill Goodykoontz

reviews.text: Baby Driver is an indelible cinematic sugar rush and is further proof that Edgar Wright is the true saviour of popcorn cinema.
reviews.author: Alistair Ryder

reviews.text: Edgar Wright puts pedal to the metal, delivering a genre-spin that's colossal entertainment.
reviews.author: Joanna Langfield

reviews.text: Baby Driver is filled with fascinating characters who could all be the focus of their own movies.
reviews.author: Rick Bentley

reviews.text: Wright secured the rights to the songs before he started production, then shot and edited the sequences to match the rhythm and energy of the tunes, the effect is often electrifying.
reviews.author: Gary Thompson

reviews.text: After seeing Baby Driver, every other action movie - no matter the high production value and star power - will just seem lazy.
reviews.author: Elena Nicolaou

reviews.text: With Wright in the driver's seat, your standard getaway driver story is transformed into a giddy, adrenaline-filled joyride that'll leave you gripping the edge of your seat and tapping your feet.
reviews.author: Devan Coggan

reviews.text: When all cylinders are pumping, Baby Driver is an enchanting experiment that puts the pedal to the metal. And even a few off notes can't stop the beat of Wright's fast and furious symphony.
reviews.author: Brian Truitt

reviews.text: Wright edits the film almost perfectly to the music, creating a kinetic rush of a cinematic experience.
reviews.author: Don Kaye

reviews.text: The coolest movie of the summer.
reviews.author: Mike Ryan

reviews.text: It's cute, to be sure, but is it anything more than that? Maybe it doesn't have to be.
reviews.author: Katie Walsh

reviews.text: The regrettable truth is that Baby's a dull boy.
reviews.author: Anthony Lane

reviews.text: An exciting, gleeful movie.
reviews.author: Jeffrey M. Anderson

reviews.text: Arrives like the Calvary to save our depressingly franchise-heavy summer movie season.
reviews.author: Matt Prigge

reviews.text: Just what you want a summer movie to be.
reviews.author: Moira MacDonald

reviews.text: Put up against [Wright's] earlier work, it wilts.
reviews.author: J. Olson

reviews.text: Fueled by a retro soundtrack and an anarchic spirit, Baby Driver is like Drive on speed.
reviews.author: Kevin Lally

reviews.text: Wright is savvy enough to realize that suspense and tension require characters that are more than human figures in a CGI playground. He does just enough with the men and women populating Baby Driver for us to get a sense of who they are.
reviews.author: James Berardinelli

reviews.text: Feels both influenced by the modern era of self-aware, pop-culture filmmaking and charmingly old-fashioned at the same time, which is only one of its minor miracles.
reviews.author: Brian Tallerico

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a music-driven, adrenaline-pumping ballet of sight and sound that needs to be seen on the big screen to fully enjoy.
reviews.author: Jason Zingale

reviews.text: A high-wire, hyper-cool, adrenaline-fueled fusion of music, action and ecstasy. There has never been anything quite like what writer-director Edgar Wright has accomplished.
reviews.author: Dustin Putman

reviews.text: Baby Driver is a turbo-charged action classic.
reviews.author: Julian Roman

reviews.text: The movie is a foot-tapping, sing-a-long gas, though, like many a summer movie before it, it's best if you don't spend too much time reflecting on its twists and turns, or expect much emotional involvement.
reviews.author: Will Leitch

reviews.text: Edgar Wright put a YA storyline into a heist plot. Unfortunately, sweet Elgort - a criminal - has no dark edges. Baby has 8 out of 10 symptoms of Asperger's Syndrome.
reviews.author: Victoria Alexander

reviews.text: Baby Driver literalizes Edgar Wright's fascination with people's emotional overreliance on pop culture as a cover for arrested development.
reviews.author: Jake Cole

reviews.text: [A] curious, coddling delight.
reviews.author: Armond White

reviews.text: By using music as a way to tell us about character and emotions, Wright isn't simply doing cool stuff with the soundtrack. He's showing us something that's both beautiful and tragic about his protagonist. He gives us a movie you'll want to put on repeat.
reviews.author: Matt Goldberg

reviews.text: Loads of fun, Baby Driver gives a great ride.
reviews.author: Edward Douglas

reviews.text: Baby Driver is certainly an entertaining ride but when you pop the hood there's not much under its shiny surface.
reviews.author: Ian Sandwell

reviews.text: You don't just leave this 112-minute movie smiling; you leaved so pumped and energized, you may just want to turn around, strap in and take the sweet ride all over again.
reviews.author: Stephen Rebello

reviews.text: If not the best movie of the year, it's definitely the most fun. The premise may be familiar, but we've never seen it done quite like this before.
reviews.author: Chris Bumbray

reviews.text: Probably the best film in cinema history whose plot is driven by a young man's tinnitus. I dare any other studio to have a better soundtrack this year.
reviews.author: Harvey S. Karten

reviews.text: This is the first thriller I've seen in a long time that feels handmade.
reviews.author: David Edelstein

reviews.text: An awe-inspiring piece of filmmaking from Edgar Wright. Sweet, funny and utterly original - you won't see a film like it this year.
reviews.author: Terri White

reviews.text: It zips along at a fast pace, cruising on cool characters and a nifty knack for nailing every beat in every scene.
reviews.author: Matt Looker

reviews.text: The relationship between music and motion proves the defining attribute of Edgar Wright's thrilling latest.
reviews.author: Josh Slater-Williams

reviews.text: Baby Driver proves once again that Edgar Wright is a creative genius and can take on any genre and knock it out of the park.
reviews.author: Scott Menzel

reviews.text: Baby Driver is hopefully the first in a long line of experimental films from accomplished auteur Edgar Wright.
reviews.author: Jon Espino

reviews.text: Baby Driver is exhilarating, fantastically entertaining, and mildly frustrating, all at the same time. Wright's directorial execution has never been better, and he's able to construct chase sequences that put the Fast and Furious series to shame.
reviews.author: Bryan Bishop

reviews.text: With Baby Driver, Edgar Wright is officially five-for-five, a rare accomplishment in filmmaking and one that basically guarantees his elevation to all-timer status.
reviews.author: Britt Hayes

reviews.text: Even though the story isn't as impactful as its stylized packaging, Wright creates a delightful new film that is sure to satisfy his legions of fans.
reviews.author: Terri Schwartz

reviews.text: Tapping less into emotions and more into adrenaline and wonder, it's more style than substance, but oh, what style!
reviews.author: Kristy Puchko

reviews.text: Equal parts slapstick and visceral thrills, but never too far from a reality check.
reviews.author: Eric Kohn

reviews.text: The movie exists in this dreamlike state of ecstasy for nearly 70 minutes. Then there's a peculiar pivot into conventionality.
reviews.author: Sam Fragoso

reviews.text: This is a ride well worth taking and one that will leave you with a smile on your face (and many, many earworms) long after credits roll.
reviews.author: Dan Casey

reviews.text: Baby Driver is an ode to those who need a stream of tunes in their heads, everywhere, all the time, and a cinematic high-five to the movies that made Wright the absurdly talented music-n-film dork he is today.
reviews.author: Joe Gross

reviews.text: A curious blend of heightened comical world building and legitimate tragedy and danger.
reviews.author: Joanna Robinson

reviews.text: To the strains of what will undoubtedly become the soundtrack of the summer, Baby Driver can grab the spoils and take a victory lap.
reviews.author: Jane Mulkerrins

reviews.text: A Fast and Furious Fantasia that stands apart from the pack.
reviews.author: Erik Childress

reviews.text: Plays out like blasting your coolest friend's record collection in your car at 100 mph on the Atlanta freeway while cops close in on all sides - essentially what happens in the movie again and again, to always-riveting effect.
reviews.author: Jada Yuan

reviews.text: Baby Driver proves why we should never doubt Edgar Wright's vision, because few filmmakers can back their ambition with such quality thrills.
reviews.author: Matt Donato

reviews.text: Like a juggler balancing spinning plates, Baby Driver would fall apart if it ever stopped moving. As long as the plates are spinning, though, it's magic.
reviews.author: Joshua Starnes

reviews.text: So rhythmic, so kinetic, that it pulls you into its cadence, bringing you into Baby's world as surely as if you were sharing headphones.
reviews.author: Meredith Borders

reviews.text: Edgar Wright returns with an incredible heist movie, built with love, precision and a great deal of fun. His best film yet, and surely one of the best films of the year.
reviews.author: Nathan McVay

reviews.text: If Wright keeps creating original masterpieces like Baby Driver, maybe that throws down the gauntlet for the big franchises to keep up!
reviews.author: Fred Topel

reviews.text: Like all Edgar Wright movies, "Baby Driver" is a blast, featuring wall-to-wall music and a surfeit of inspired ideas. But it's also something of a mess ...
reviews.author: Peter Debruge

reviews.text: A sweet and speed-crazed crime film you can dance to.
reviews.author: John DeFore

reviews.text: This is the La La Land of car chase movies, a jaw-shattering spectacle of sight and sound that sets the bar through the roof for any filmmakers currently cutting their teeth in music videos.
reviews.author: Michael Roffman

reviews.text: A supercool and ultragroovy heist flick that uses music the way the rest of us use air, and an instant candidate for one of the best car chase movies ever.
reviews.author: William Bibbiani

synopsis: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.
